pr_title: do not reset is_visible for each camera
pr_body:
# Objective

- Fix #5019, fix #5033
- #4489 changed the `is_visible` reset to happen for each camera, so only the last was kept

## Solution

- Move the `is_visible` reset outside of the camera loop, as it was before
